title: Azure / Cache for Redis / Overview
description: Azure Cache for Redis (Microsoft.Cache/redis): inventory and per-cache Azure Monitor metrics. Managed by Terraform (azure-managed-grafana): edit dashboards/redis/azure-cache-for-redis-overview.json, not the dashboard in the UI. Changes made in Grafana are overwritten on the next apply. Azure Cache for Redis Basic/Standard/Premium retire on 2028-09-30: migrate to Azure Managed Redis (see the 'Azure / Managed Redis / Overview' dashboard).

links.title: Azure portal
links.tooltip: Open the selected resource in the Azure portal

links.title: Diagnose and solve problems
links.tooltip: Azure's built-in diagnostics for the selected resource

links.title: Operations overview
links.tooltip: State, alerts and changes across all covered resources

panels.title: Troubleshooting - $resource
panels.description: Start here when something looks wrong: is the resource running, has an alert fired, what changed? Resource Graph data; it lags a few minutes behind Azure. Grafana's identity needs read access (Monitoring Reader) on the resource.

panels.title: State
panels.description: Current state from Azure Resource Manager. Green: running/ready. Red: stopped, deallocated, failed or disabled. Orange: anything else, e.g. updating or starting.

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'Microsoft.Cache/redis' and resourceGroup =~ '$rg' and name =~ '$resource'
| project ['Provisioning'] = tostring(properties.provisioningState)

panels.title: Open alerts
panels.description: Azure Monitor alerts fired on this resource and not closed (alerts are kept 30 days). History across resources: the bundled Azure / Alert Consumption dashboard.

azureResourceGraph.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend e = properties.essentials
| where tolower(tostring(e.targetResource)) == tolower('/subscriptions/$sub/resourceGroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.Cache/redis/$resource')
| where tostring(e.monitorCondition) == 'Fired' and tostring(e.alertState) != 'Closed'
| summarize ['Open alerts'] = count()

panels.title: Changes (time range)
panels.description: Resource Manager changes to this resource and its child resources in the time range (Resource Graph change history, kept 14 days). Details on the right.

azureResourceGraph.query:
resourcechanges
| extend target = tolower(tostring(properties.targetResourceId))
| where (target == tolower('/subscriptions/$sub/resourceGroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.Cache/redis/$resource') or target startswith strcat(tolower('/subscriptions/$sub/resourceGroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.Cache/redis/$resource'), '/'))
| where todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp) between ($__timeFrom() .. $__timeTo())
| summarize Changes = count()

panels.title: What changed
panels.description: Latest Resource Manager changes in the time range: who changed what, with which operation, and which properties. A change just before a problem started is the first suspect.

azureResourceGraph.query:
resourcechanges
| extend target = tolower(tostring(properties.targetResourceId))
| where (target == tolower('/subscriptions/$sub/resourceGroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.Cache/redis/$resource') or target startswith strcat(tolower('/subscriptions/$sub/resourceGroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.Cache/redis/$resource'), '/'))
| where todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp) between ($__timeFrom() .. $__timeTo())
| project Time = todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp),
          Change = tostring(properties.changeType),
          Resource = iff(target == tolower('/subscriptions/$sub/resourceGroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.Cache/redis/$resource'), '(this resource)', substring(target, strlen(tolower('/subscriptions/$sub/resourceGroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.Cache/redis/$resource')) + 1)),
          ['Changed by'] = tostring(properties.changeAttributes.changedBy),
          Operation = tostring(properties.changeAttributes.operation),
          Properties = strcat_array(bag_keys(properties.changes), ', ')
| order by Time desc
| take 50

panels.title: Inventory: all Azure Cache for Redis caches in the subscription
Azure Cache for Redis instances ($sub)
panels.description: All Microsoft.Cache/redis caches in the selected subscription (Azure Resource Graph). Basic, Standard and Premium tiers retire on 2028-09-30 (disabled from 2028-10-01): plan the migration to Azure Managed Redis (https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-cache-for-redis/retirement-faq).

azureResourceGraph.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.cache/redis'
| extend skuName = tostring(properties.sku.name), skuSize = strcat(tostring(properties.sku.family), tostring(properties.sku.capacity))
| project name, resourceGroup, location, sku = skuName, size = skuSize, shardCount = toint(properties.shardCount), replicasPerPrimary = toint(properties.replicasPerPrimary), redisVersion = tostring(properties.redisVersion), provisioningState = tostring(properties.provisioningState), zones = tostring(zones)
| order by name asc

panels.title: Server load
panels.description: Max server load across shards (serverLoad, Maximum). Sustained > 80% causes latency and timeouts.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Max CPU across shards (percentProcessorTime, Maximum).

panels.title: Used memory
panels.description: Max used memory percentage across shards (usedmemorypercentage, Maximum).

panels.title: Connected clients
panels.description: connectedclients, Maximum.

panels.title: Operations / s
panels.description: operationsPerSecond, Maximum.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: hits / (hits + misses) over the selected time range, from cachehits and cachemisses (Total). A low ratio is normal for some cache-aside workloads.

panels.title: Cache read
panels.description: cacheRead, Maximum (network ingress to the cache).

panels.title: Cache write
panels.description: cacheWrite, Maximum (network egress from the cache).

panels.title: Server load by shard
panels.description: serverLoad, Maximum, split by ShardId.

panels.title: Server load: primary vs replica
panels.description: allserverLoad (instance based), Maximum, split by the Primary dimension (true = primary node).

panels.title: CPU by shard
panels.description: percentProcessorTime, Maximum, split by ShardId. Can be noisy because of background processes.

panels.title: Cache read / write bandwidth
panels.description: cacheRead and cacheWrite, Maximum. Compare with the bandwidth limit of the cache size.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: LatencyP99 (Maximum) and cacheLatency (Average, preview), both in microseconds.

panels.title: Operations per second by shard
panels.description: operationsPerSecond, Maximum, split by ShardId.

panels.title: Gets / sets / total operations
panels.description: getcommands, setcommands, totalcommandsprocessed (Total per time grain).

panels.title: Cache hits / misses
panels.description: cachehits and cachemisses (Total per time grain).

panels.title: Used memory % by shard
panels.description: usedmemorypercentage, Maximum, split by ShardId.

panels.title: Used memory by shard
panels.description: usedmemory (key/value data, no fragmentation), Maximum, split by ShardId.

panels.title: Used memory RSS by shard
panels.description: usedmemoryRss (includes fragmentation and metadata), Maximum, split by ShardId.

panels.title: Total keys by shard
panels.description: totalkeys, Maximum, split by ShardId.

panels.title: Evicted keys by shard
panels.description: evictedkeys (maxmemory evictions), Total per time grain, split by ShardId. Non-zero means memory pressure.

panels.title: Expired keys by shard
panels.description: expiredkeys (TTL expirations), Total per time grain, split by ShardId.

panels.title: Connected clients by shard
panels.description: connectedclients, Maximum, split by ShardId. New connections fail once the tier limit is reached.

panels.title: Connections created / closed per second
panels.description: allConnectionsCreatedPerSecond and allConnectionsClosedPerSecond (instance based), Maximum per node. High churn raises CPU and server load.

panels.title: Errors by type
panels.description: errors, Maximum, split by ErrorType (Failover, Dataloss, UnresponsiveClients, AOF, RDB, Import, Export, MicrosoftEntraAuthenticationFailure, MicrosoftEntraTokenExpired).

panels.title: Geo-replication healthy
panels.description: GeoReplicationHealthy, Minimum (1 healthy, 0 unhealthy). Emitted by the geo-secondary only.

panels.title: Geo-replication connectivity lag
panels.description: GeoReplicationConnectivityLag, Maximum: seconds since the last successful sync. Keeps increasing while the link is down. Emitted by the geo-secondary only.

panels.title: Geo-replication data sync offset
panels.description: GeoReplicationDataSyncOffset, Maximum: bytes not yet synchronized. Emitted by the geo-primary only.
